title: FrostySouls an Optimized TimedLife data pack Recoded
description: Frosty Souls is a thrilling Minecraft datapack that challenges players to manage their time as they gather rare blocks to extend their lifespans. With a ticking clock, every decision counts; once your time runs out, the ultimate consequence awaits—death.
body:
Frosty Souls Datapack
A completely recoded and highly optimized datapack designed for large multiplayer servers. The original TimedLife datapack suffered from significant TPS (Ticks Per Second) issues, but Frosty Souls fixes those performance problems to ensure smooth gameplay, even with many players.
Original mod: [OrginalMod](https://modrinth.com/datapack/timedlife)

What is Frosty Souls?
Frosty Souls introduces a thrilling, time-based survival challenge to Minecraft. Players start with a limited lifespan, and the countdown begins as soon as they move. Your goal? To extend your remaining time by consuming rare blocks, adding an intense layer of strategy and survival.

How to Play:
Start: Time starts ticking as soon as you move.
Gain Time: Stand on netherite blocks, sneak, and consume them to increase your remaining time.
Survive: Manage your resources carefully to extend your life by strategically placing and consuming rare blocks.
Consequence: If your timer hits zero, you face instant death.
Multiplayer Support:
Whether playing solo or with friends, this pack ensures that everyone can enjoy the challenge together. Compete to see who can last the longest!

Upgrading from TimedLife:
To upgrade from the previous TimedLife datapack, run the uninstall function in the new pack, then execute the reload function in Frosty Souls.
Note: All commands still use the original timedlife prefix.
The transition is seamless, but keep in mind that everyone’s time will be reset.

Your time is precious – use it wisely!

Changes in the Frosty Souls Datapack:

Track Netherite Blocks: Track players consumed Netherite Blocks directly on the tab list for easy monitoring

Optimized Performance: Ensures minimal impact on TPS, even with large player counts.

Sidebar Display: Track player time directly on the side bar for easy monitoring.
